# Muhammad Azizi — Full Stack Developer

> Muhammad Azizi is a full stack developer based in Pakistan who ships reliable web products from idea to production. He builds with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Supabase, and MongoDB, and develops high-converting custom Shopify themes with Liquid. His work spans SaaS products, e-commerce stores, travel and corporate websites, and offline desktop applications. He works remotely with clients worldwide.

## Services

- Full stack product development: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL and Supabase.
- SaaS product development: multi-tenant apps, auth, billing-ready architecture, and dashboards.
- Shopify theme development: custom Liquid themes, performance, CRO, and app integrations.

## Projects

- SoFyre (https://sofyre.com): Live Shopify store selling plant-based pest control products. Custom theme, CRO, and subscription refills. Stack: Shopify, Liquid, UI/UX, SEO.
- Gilgit Adventure Treks (https://gilgitadventuretreks.com): Adventure and trekking company website with an AI trip planner and online booking. Stack: HTML/CSS, JavaScript, booking system, SEO.
- MAS Corporates (https://mascorporates.com): Corporate website for a construction and engineering firm. Stack: HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, SEO.
- Terra Pakistan (https://terrapakistan.com): Travel company website built with Next.js covering tours across Northern Pakistan. Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, SEO.
- Cheech and Chong (https://cheechandchong.com): Custom responsive Shopify store. Stack: Shopify, Liquid, UI/UX.
- RexiPets (https://rexipets.com): Custom responsive Shopify pet e-commerce store. Stack: Shopify, Liquid, UI/UX.
- Happy Being Shop: Custom Shopify store for organic white tea and variety packs. Stack: Shopify, Liquid, UI/UX.
- Gilgit Midway Hotel Manager: Fully offline desktop hotel management dashboard. Stack: Python, Django.
- Point of Sales: Fully offline desktop POS and billing application. Stack: Python, Django.
